# SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — not a recorded capture from any real card.
# Authored 2026-10-19 from the documented format set of the Macrosilicon
# MS2109-class USB 2 capture card (uvcvideo, MJPG only: the USB 2 link cannot
# carry raw YUYV at 720p and above, so this class exposes compressed MJPG).
# Shape is stock v4l2-ctl --list-formats-ext output so it parses through
# devices.ParseFormatsExt unchanged.

	Type: Video Capture

	[0]: 'MJPG' (Motion-JPEG, compressed)
		Size: Discrete 640x480
			Interval: Stepwise 0.033s - 0.500s [2.000 - 30.000 fps]
		Size: Discrete 1280x720
			Interval: Stepwise 0.033s - 0.500s [2.000 - 30.000 fps]
		Size: Discrete 1920x1080
			Interval: Stepwise 0.067s - 0.500s [2.000 - 15.000 fps]
